name: Prusa MINI RME 0.4 nozzle
description: For RME firmware. Uses the stock single-tool hardware settings and pressure-advance values; loadcell-based M976 calibration is not supported on this printer.
machine_start_gcode:
; RME_DEPOSITION_BOUNDS=1
M862.3 P "MINI" ; printer model check
M862.1 P[nozzle_diameter] ; nozzle diameter check
M862.5 P2 ; g-code level check
M862.6 P"Input shaper" ; FW feature check
M115 U6.4.0+11974
G90 ; use absolute coordinates
M83 ; extruder relative mode
G28 ; home all without mesh bed level
M104 S170 ; set extruder temp for bed leveling
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; set bed temp
M109 R170 ; wait for bed leveling temp
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; wait for bed temp
M569 S1 X Y ; set stealthchop for X Y
M204 T1250 ; set travel acceleration
G29 ; mesh bed leveling 
M104 S[first_layer_temperature] ; set extruder temp
G92 E0

G1 X0 Y-2 Z3 F2400

M109 S[first_layer_temperature] ; wait for extruder temp

; intro line
G1 X10 Z0.2 F1000
G1 X70 E8 F900
G1 X140 E10 F700
G92 E0

M569 S0 X Y ; set spreadcycle for X Y
M204 T[machine_max_acceleration_travel] ; restore travel acceleration
M572 W0.06 ; set smooth time
M221 S95 ; set flow
